description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation - Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No. 34 of 2002, order under Section 09
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, boundaries, and exact measurements) being added to the schedule of "Aeronautical Facilities and land appertaining thereto" under the Civil Aviation Authority Act. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the main purpose of documenting land registrations and property boundaries for aviation facilities, making it primarily a land-related gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
